seed._comment: Baseline data fed into the DB before the suite runs (see cypress/support/seed/dbSeed.ts). The seed plant is identified by its sub-category, so the plant-update tests renaming it does not break cleanup. App constraints: category name 3-10 chars; plants attach to SUB-categories only; a SOLD plant cannot be deleted (inventory FK), so cleanup removes the seed sales every run and reuses the seed plant/categories.

malinda._comment: Data used by Malinda's test cases. IDs that depend on DB state are resolved at runtime via cy.task('db:seed').
